descriptions.it:
TSMG cerca Depot Specialist (Robotaxi Fleet Operations) per attivita operative sul territorio a St. Gallen. Di seguito trovi il testo integrale dell'annuncio Lever, con responsabilita, requisiti e dettagli pratici del progetto. Siamo alla ricerca di specialisti del deposito per sostenere le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi (AV) e flotte robotassi in tutta Europa. Come Specialista del deposito, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire veicoli autonomi sono puliti, completamente carica, ispezionati, e operativamente pronti per la distribuzione quotidiana. Lavorando da un deposito robotassi dedicato, supporterete la preparazione del veicolo, la prontezza della flotta, la gestione dell'inventario e le operazioni di deposito giorno per giorno che consentono servizi di guida autonomi sicuri e affidabili. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati che godono di lavoro pratico, sono altamente organizzati e prosperano in ambienti operativi veloci. Non è richiesta alcuna esperienza precedente con veicoli autonomi - sarà prevista la formazione. Unendo il nostro team, contribuirai direttamente al lancio, al funzionamento e allo scaling di flotte robotassi e servizi di mobilità autonomi in più città europee. ## Panoramica del progetto ## Principali responsabilità - Preparare veicoli autonomi per le operazioni giornaliere della flotta robotassi. - Assicurarsi che ogni veicolo sia pulito, ispezionato, caricato e pronto per la distribuzione prima dell'inizio di ogni turno. - Verificare la pulizia e la condizione delle telecamere, LiDAR, radar, specchi, sensori, finestre e interni del veicolo per supportare le prestazioni del sistema auto-driving ottimali. - Eseguire le ispezioni pre-deployment e post-shift seguendo le procedure operative stabilite. - Monitorare i livelli di batteria e gli orari di ricarica per veicoli autonomi elettrici. - Supporta le operazioni quotidiane del deposito robotassi coordinando il movimento del veicolo, il parcheggio, la ricarica e la staging. - Assistere con i processi di spedizione e ritorno del veicolo. - Organizzare aree di parcheggio per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa. - Mantenere la pulizia del deposito e garantire aree di lavoro conformi agli standard di sicurezza. - Coordinate la disponibilità del veicolo con operatori di sicurezza, tecnici e operazioni piombo. - Eseguire controlli di funzionalità del veicolo di base prima dell'implementazione. - Verificare condizioni di pneumatici, illuminazione, livelli di fluido, apparecchiature di ricarica e condizioni generali del veicolo. - Identificare danni cosmetici o problemi operativi che richiedono un'ispezione tecnica. - Escalate le preoccupazioni di manutenzione per i tecnici senior o gli specialisti SDS. - Supporta le attività di recupero e trasporto del veicolo quando necessario. - Mantenere l'inventario dei materiali di pulizia, accessori di ricarica, PPE e attrezzature operative. - Traccia l'uso dell'inventario e segnala le esigenze di rifornimento. - Ricevere consegne e organizzare aree di deposito deposito deposito. - Assistere con la logistica che supporta l'espansione della flotta e nuovi lancio del deposito. - Elenchi di controllo digitali completi e rapporti di disponibilità della flotta. - Registra lo stato del veicolo, le informazioni di ricarica e le osservazioni operative. - Seguire le procedure di sicurezza del deposito e gli standard operativi aziendali. - Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo che aumentano la disponibilità della flotta, ridurre i tempi di fermo e migliorare l'efficienza operativa. ##
• Requisiti - Una patente valida. - Guida confortevole sia veicoli elettrici che convenzionali. - Buone capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo. - Forte attenzione ai dettagli. - Literacy del computer di base. - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra. - Confortevole lavoro in ambienti interni ed esterni. - Capacità di lavorare turni flessibili, tra cui serate, fine settimana e vacanze quando necessario. - Inglese superiore intermedio. - Esperienza nelle operazioni di flotta, logistica, operazioni di magazzino, dettagli automobilistici o trasporti. - Esperienza di lavoro con veicoli elettrici (EVs). - Conoscenza meccanica di base. - Esperienza che supporta ambienti operativi 24/7. - La certificazione del carrello elevatore o l'esperienza logistica è un vantaggio. ## Cosa stiamo cercando Gli specialisti del deposito di successo stanno mantenendo elevati standard operativi e capiscono che la disponibilità del veicolo è fondamentale per il successo delle flotte autonome e delle operazioni di robotassi commerciali. Si gode di lavoro strutturato, hanno un'attenzione eccellente ai dettagli, e capire l'importanza di garantire ogni veicolo autonomo lascia il deposito pulito, caricato, sicuro, e completamente preparato per il servizio clienti o le operazioni di test. Non è richiesta alcuna esperienza di robotassi o veicoli autonomi - forniamo una formazione completa sulle procedure di deposito, la preparazione del veicolo e le operazioni della flotta. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di sostenere alcuni dei più avanzati robotassi e programmi autonome in Europa. - Lavorare con veicoli elettrici e autonomi all'avanguardia. - Addestramento completo e formazione operativa. - Opportunità di carriera a lungo termine all'interno delle operazioni della flotta, mobilità autonoma e distribuzione robotassi. - Esposizione alla gestione dei depositi, disponibilità della flotta, operazioni del veicolo e servizi di guida autonomi commerciali. - Ambiente collaborativo che collabora con gli operatori di sicurezza, i tecnici, gli ingegneri e le squadre di gestione delle flotte. - Opportunità di sostenere nuovi lanci di città, configurazione del deposito e l'espansione delle flotte autonome di corsa in tutta Europa.
descriptions.en:
TSMG is hiring Depot Specialist (Robotaxi Fleet Operations) for field operations in St. Gallen. Below is the full Lever job description with responsibilities, requirements and practical project details.

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Prepare autonomous vehicles for daily robotaxi fleet operations.
- Ensure every vehicle is cleaned, inspected, charged, and deployment-ready before the start of each shift.
- Verify the cleanliness and condition of cameras, LiDAR, radar, mirrors, sensors, windows, and vehicle interiors to support optimal self-driving system performance.
- Perform pre-deployment and post-shift inspections following established operational procedures.
- Monitor battery levels and charging schedules for electric autonomous vehicles.
- Support daily robotaxi depot operations by coordinating vehicle movement, parking, charging, and staging.
- Assist with vehicle dispatch and return processes.
- Organize parking areas to maximize operational efficiency.
- Maintain depot cleanliness and ensure work areas comply with safety standards.
- Coordinate vehicle availability with Safety Operators, Technicians, and Operations Leads.
- Perform basic vehicle functionality checks before deployment.
- Verify tire condition, lighting, fluid levels, charging equipment, and general vehicle condition.
- Identify cosmetic damage or operational issues requiring technical inspection.
- Escalate maintenance concerns to Senior Technicians or SDS Specialists.
- Support vehicle recovery and transportation activities when required.
- Maintain inventory of cleaning materials, charging accessories, PPE, and operational equipment.
- Track inventory usage and report replenishment needs.
- Receive deliveries and organize depot storage areas.
- Assist with logistics supporting fleet expansion and new depot launches.
- Complete digital inspection checklists and fleet readiness reports.
- Record vehicle status, charging information, and operational observations.
- Follow depot safety procedures and company operational standards.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives that increase fleet availability, reduce downtime, and improve operational efficiency.

## Requirements

- Valid driver's license.
- Comfortable driving both electric and conventional vehicles.
- Good organizational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Basic computer literacy.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Comfortable working in indoor and outdoor environments.
- Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.
- Upper-Intermediate English.
- Experience in fleet operations, logistics, warehouse operations, automotive detailing, or transportation.
- Experience working with electric vehicles (EVs).
- Basic mechanical knowledge.
- Experience supporting 24/7 operational environments.
- Forklift certification or logistics experience is an advantage.

## What We're Looking For

Successful Depot Specialists are maintaining high operational standards and understand that vehicle readiness is critical to the success of autonomous vehicle fleets and commercial robotaxi operations.

You enjoy structured work, have excellent attention to detail, and understand the importance of ensuring every autonomous vehicle leaves the depot clean, charged, safe, and fully prepared for customer service or testing operations.

No previous robotaxi or autonomous vehicle experience is required - we provide comprehensive training on depot procedures, vehicle preparation, and fleet operations.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to support some of Europe's most advanced robotaxi and autonomous vehicle programs.
- Work with cutting-edge electric and autonomous vehicles.
- Comprehensive onboarding and operational training.
- Long-term career opportunities within fleet operations, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi deployment.
- Exposure to depot management, fleet readiness, vehicle operations, and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Collaborative environment working alongside Safety Operators, Technicians, Engineers, and Fleet Operations teams.
- Opportunity to support new city launches, depot setup, and the expansion of autonomous ride-hailing fleets across Europe.

TSMG is hiring Depot Specialist (Robotaxi Fleet Operations) for field operations in Bern. Below is the full Lever job description with responsibilities, requirements and practical project details.

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Prepare autonomous vehicles for daily robotaxi fleet operations.
- Ensure every vehicle is cleaned, inspected, charged, and deployment-ready before the start of each shift.
- Verify the cleanliness and condition of cameras, LiDAR, radar, mirrors, sensors, windows, and vehicle interiors to support optimal self-driving system performance.
- Perform pre-deployment and post-shift inspections following established operational procedures.
- Monitor battery levels and charging schedules for electric autonomous vehicles.
- Support daily robotaxi depot operations by coordinating vehicle movement, parking, charging, and staging.
- Assist with vehicle dispatch and return processes.
- Organize parking areas to maximize operational efficiency.
- Maintain depot cleanliness and ensure work areas comply with safety standards.
- Coordinate vehicle availability with Safety Operators, Technicians, and Operations Leads.
- Perform basic vehicle functionality checks before deployment.
- Verify tire condition, lighting, fluid levels, charging equipment, and general vehicle condition.
- Identify cosmetic damage or operational issues requiring technical inspection.
- Escalate maintenance concerns to Senior Technicians or SDS Specialists.
- Support vehicle recovery and transportation activities when required.
- Maintain inventory of cleaning materials, charging accessories, PPE, and operational equipment.
- Track inventory usage and report replenishment needs.
- Receive deliveries and organize depot storage areas.
- Assist with logistics supporting fleet expansion and new depot launches.
- Complete digital inspection checklists and fleet readiness reports.
- Record vehicle status, charging information, and operational observations.
- Follow depot safety procedures and company operational standards.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives that increase fleet availability, reduce downtime, and improve operational efficiency.

## Requirements

- Valid driver's license.
- Comfortable driving both electric and conventional vehicles.
- Good organizational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Basic computer literacy.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Comfortable working in indoor and outdoor environments.
- Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.
- Upper-Intermediate English.
- Experience in fleet operations, logistics, warehouse operations, automotive detailing, or transportation.
- Experience working with electric vehicles (EVs).
- Basic mechanical knowledge.
- Experience supporting 24/7 operational environments.
- Forklift certification or logistics experience is an advantage.

## What We're Looking For

Successful Depot Specialists are maintaining high operational standards and understand that vehicle readiness is critical to the success of autonomous vehicle fleets and commercial robotaxi operations.

You enjoy structured work, have excellent attention to detail, and understand the importance of ensuring every autonomous vehicle leaves the depot clean, charged, safe, and fully prepared for customer service or testing operations.

No previous robotaxi or autonomous vehicle experience is required - we provide comprehensive training on depot procedures, vehicle preparation, and fleet operations.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to support some of Europe's most advanced robotaxi and autonomous vehicle programs.
- Work with cutting-edge electric and autonomous vehicles.
- Comprehensive onboarding and operational training.
- Long-term career opportunities within fleet operations, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi deployment.
- Exposure to depot management, fleet readiness, vehicle operations, and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Collaborative environment working alongside Safety Operators, Technicians, Engineers, and Fleet Operations teams.
- Opportunity to support new city launches, depot setup, and the expansion of autonomous ride-hailing fleets across Europe.

descriptions.it:
TSMG cerca Depot Specialist (Robotaxi Fleet Operations) per attivita operative sul territorio a Zurigo. Di seguito trovi il testo integrale dell'annuncio Lever, con responsabilita, requisiti e dettagli pratici del progetto. Siamo alla ricerca di specialisti del deposito per sostenere le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi (AV) e flotte robotassi in tutta Europa. Come Specialista del deposito, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire veicoli autonomi sono puliti, completamente carica, ispezionati, e operativamente pronti per la distribuzione quotidiana. Lavorando da un deposito robotassi dedicato, supporterete la preparazione del veicolo, la prontezza della flotta, la gestione dell'inventario e le operazioni di deposito giorno per giorno che consentono servizi di guida autonomi sicuri e affidabili. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati che godono di lavoro pratico, sono altamente organizzati e prosperano in ambienti operativi veloci. Non è richiesta alcuna esperienza precedente con veicoli autonomi - sarà prevista la formazione. Unendo il nostro team, contribuirai direttamente al lancio, al funzionamento e allo scaling di flotte robotassi e servizi di mobilità autonomi in più città europee. ## Panoramica del progetto ## Principali responsabilità - Preparare veicoli autonomi per le operazioni giornaliere della flotta robotassi. - Assicurarsi che ogni veicolo sia pulito, ispezionato, caricato e pronto per la distribuzione prima dell'inizio di ogni turno. - Verificare la pulizia e la condizione delle telecamere, LiDAR, radar, specchi, sensori, finestre e interni del veicolo per supportare le prestazioni del sistema auto-driving ottimali. - Eseguire le ispezioni pre-deployment e post-shift seguendo le procedure operative stabilite. - Monitorare i livelli di batteria e gli orari di ricarica per veicoli autonomi elettrici. - Supporta le operazioni quotidiane del deposito robotassi coordinando il movimento del veicolo, il parcheggio, la ricarica e la staging. - Assistere con i processi di spedizione e ritorno del veicolo. - Organizzare aree di parcheggio per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa. - Mantenere la pulizia del deposito e garantire aree di lavoro conformi agli standard di sicurezza. - Coordinate la disponibilità del veicolo con operatori di sicurezza, tecnici e operazioni piombo. - Eseguire controlli di funzionalità del veicolo di base prima dell'implementazione. - Verificare condizioni di pneumatici, illuminazione, livelli di fluido, apparecchiature di ricarica e condizioni generali del veicolo. - Identificare danni cosmetici o problemi operativi che richiedono un'ispezione tecnica. - Escalate le preoccupazioni di manutenzione per i tecnici senior o gli specialisti SDS. - Supporta le attività di recupero e trasporto del veicolo quando necessario. - Mantenere l'inventario dei materiali di pulizia, accessori di ricarica, PPE e attrezzature operative. - Traccia l'uso dell'inventario e segnala le esigenze di rifornimento. - Ricevere consegne e organizzare aree di deposito deposito deposito. - Assistere con la logistica che supporta l'espansione della flotta e nuovi lancio del deposito. - Elenchi di controllo digitali completi e rapporti di disponibilità della flotta. - Registra lo stato del veicolo, le informazioni di ricarica e le osservazioni operative. - Seguire le procedure di sicurezza del deposito e gli standard operativi aziendali. - Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo che aumentano la disponibilità della flotta, ridurre i tempi di fermo e migliorare l'efficienza operativa. ##
• Requisiti - Una patente valida. - Guida confortevole sia veicoli elettrici che convenzionali. - Buone capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo. - Forte attenzione ai dettagli. - Literacy del computer di base. - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra. - Confortevole lavoro in ambienti interni ed esterni. - Capacità di lavorare turni flessibili, tra cui serate, fine settimana e vacanze quando necessario. - Inglese superiore intermedio. - Esperienza nelle operazioni di flotta, logistica, operazioni di magazzino, dettagli automobilistici o trasporti. - Esperienza di lavoro con veicoli elettrici (EVs). - Conoscenza meccanica di base. - Esperienza che supporta ambienti operativi 24/7. - La certificazione del carrello elevatore o l'esperienza logistica è un vantaggio. ## Cosa stiamo cercando Gli specialisti del deposito di successo stanno mantenendo elevati standard operativi e capiscono che la disponibilità del veicolo è fondamentale per il successo delle flotte autonome e delle operazioni di robotassi commerciali. Si gode di lavoro strutturato, hanno un'attenzione eccellente ai dettagli, e capire l'importanza di garantire ogni veicolo autonomo lascia il deposito pulito, caricato, sicuro, e completamente preparato per il servizio clienti o le operazioni di test. Non è richiesta alcuna esperienza di robotassi o veicoli autonomi - forniamo una formazione completa sulle procedure di deposito, la preparazione del veicolo e le operazioni della flotta. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di sostenere alcuni dei più avanzati robotassi e programmi autonome in Europa. - Lavorare con veicoli elettrici e autonomi all'avanguardia. - Addestramento completo e formazione operativa. - Opportunità di carriera a lungo termine all'interno delle operazioni della flotta, mobilità autonoma e distribuzione robotassi. - Esposizione alla gestione dei depositi, disponibilità della flotta, operazioni del veicolo e servizi di guida autonomi commerciali. - Ambiente collaborativo che collabora con gli operatori di sicurezza, i tecnici, gli ingegneri e le squadre di gestione delle flotte. - Opportunità di sostenere nuovi lanci di città, configurazione del deposito e l'espansione delle flotte autonome di corsa in tutta Europa.
descriptions.en:
TSMG is hiring Depot Specialist (Robotaxi Fleet Operations) for field operations in Zurich. Below is the full Lever job description with responsibilities, requirements and practical project details.

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for Depot Specialists to support the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets across Europe. As a Depot Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring autonomous vehicles are clean, fully charged, inspected, and operationally ready for daily deployment. Working from a dedicated robotaxi depot, you will support vehicle preparation, fleet readiness, inventory management, and day-to-day depot operations that enable safe and reliable autonomous ride-hailing services. This position is ideal for candidates who enjoy hands-on work, are highly organized, and thrive in fast-paced operational environments. No previous experience with autonomous vehicles is required - training will be provided. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the successful launch, operation, and scaling of robotaxi fleets and autonomous mobility services across multiple European cities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Prepare autonomous vehicles for daily robotaxi fleet operations.
- Ensure every vehicle is cleaned, inspected, charged, and deployment-ready before the start of each shift.
- Verify the cleanliness and condition of cameras, LiDAR, radar, mirrors, sensors, windows, and vehicle interiors to support optimal self-driving system performance.
- Perform pre-deployment and post-shift inspections following established operational procedures.
- Monitor battery levels and charging schedules for electric autonomous vehicles.
- Support daily robotaxi depot operations by coordinating vehicle movement, parking, charging, and staging.
- Assist with vehicle dispatch and return processes.
- Organize parking areas to maximize operational efficiency.
- Maintain depot cleanliness and ensure work areas comply with safety standards.
- Coordinate vehicle availability with Safety Operators, Technicians, and Operations Leads.
- Perform basic vehicle functionality checks before deployment.
- Verify tire condition, lighting, fluid levels, charging equipment, and general vehicle condition.
- Identify cosmetic damage or operational issues requiring technical inspection.
- Escalate maintenance concerns to Senior Technicians or SDS Specialists.
- Support vehicle recovery and transportation activities when required.
- Maintain inventory of cleaning materials, charging accessories, PPE, and operational equipment.
- Track inventory usage and report replenishment needs.
- Receive deliveries and organize depot storage areas.
- Assist with logistics supporting fleet expansion and new depot launches.
- Complete digital inspection checklists and fleet readiness reports.
- Record vehicle status, charging information, and operational observations.
- Follow depot safety procedures and company operational standards.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives that increase fleet availability, reduce downtime, and improve operational efficiency.

## Requirements

- Valid driver's license.
- Comfortable driving both electric and conventional vehicles.
- Good organizational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Basic computer literacy.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Comfortable working in indoor and outdoor environments.
- Ability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.
- Upper-Intermediate English.
- Experience in fleet operations, logistics, warehouse operations, automotive detailing, or transportation.
- Experience working with electric vehicles (EVs).
- Basic mechanical knowledge.
- Experience supporting 24/7 operational environments.
- Forklift certification or logistics experience is an advantage.

## What We're Looking For

Successful Depot Specialists are maintaining high operational standards and understand that vehicle readiness is critical to the success of autonomous vehicle fleets and commercial robotaxi operations.

You enjoy structured work, have excellent attention to detail, and understand the importance of ensuring every autonomous vehicle leaves the depot clean, charged, safe, and fully prepared for customer service or testing operations.

No previous robotaxi or autonomous vehicle experience is required - we provide comprehensive training on depot procedures, vehicle preparation, and fleet operations.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to support some of Europe's most advanced robotaxi and autonomous vehicle programs.
- Work with cutting-edge electric and autonomous vehicles.
- Comprehensive onboarding and operational training.
- Long-term career opportunities within fleet operations, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi deployment.
- Exposure to depot management, fleet readiness, vehicle operations, and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Collaborative environment working alongside Safety Operators, Technicians, Engineers, and Fleet Operations teams.
- Opportunity to support new city launches, depot setup, and the expansion of autonomous ride-hailing fleets across Europe.

descriptions.it:
TSMG cerca Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead per attivita operativa sul territorio a Berna. Di seguito trovi il testo integrale dell'annuncio Lever, con responsabilita, requisiti e dettagli pratici del progetto. Siamo alla ricerca di un Autonomo veicolo Operations Lead (AVOS) per supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi (AV) e flotte robotassi che supportano programmi di test, servizi di ride-hailing autonomi commerciali, e nuove città lancia in tutta Europa. Come leader operativo all'interno del deposito, si coordina operatori di sicurezza, specialisti del deposito, tecnici senior e specialisti SDS per garantire che i veicoli rimangano sicuri, operativi e pronti per la distribuzione. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel mantenere la disponibilità della flotta, incontrare i KPI operativi, e sostenere il lancio e lo scaling di flotte autonome. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati con esperienza nelle operazioni della flotta, nei servizi di mobilità, nelle operazioni automobilistiche, nella logistica o nei trasporti che godono di team leader in ambienti veloci e orientati alla tecnologia. ## Panoramica del progetto ## Principali responsabilità - Guidare le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi e flotte robotassi attraverso una o più sedi di deposito. - Assicurare che i veicoli siano pronti per supportare i test, la distribuzione commerciale e i servizi di guida autonomi. - Monitorare l'utilizzo della flotta, la disponibilità del veicolo, gli orari di ricarica e la disponibilità operativa. - Coordinare le attività quotidiane di spedizione e ritorno del veicolo per massimizzare l'efficienza della flotta. - Minimizzare i tempi di fermo del veicolo attraverso un'efficace pianificazione operativa e coordinamento. - Controllare tutte le attività all'interno del deposito robotassi, assicurando operazioni sicure, efficienti e organizzate. - Coordinare il lavoro di specialisti del deposito, operatori di sicurezza, tecnici senior e specialisti SDS. - Assicurare che i veicoli soddisfino la pulizia, la ricarica, l'ispezione e gli standard di manutenzione prima della distribuzione. - Installazione del deposito di sostegno e prontezza operativa per nuovi lanci della città e progetti di espansione della flotta. - Recluta, a bordo, treno e supervisiona il personale operativo. - Crea programmi di turni che supportano le operazioni della flotta 24/7. - Condurre recensioni sulle prestazioni e sessioni di coaching. - Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo. - Assicurare a tutti i membri del team di seguire le procedure operative e gli standard di sicurezza. - Agire come principale contatto operativo per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Coordinare le attività quotidiane con team di ingegneria, prodotto, tecnico e gestione della flotta. - Prepara report operativi, cruscotti KPI e sintesi delle prestazioni. - Escalare i rischi operativi e sviluppare piani di mitigazione. - Sostenere le visite dei clienti, gli audit e le recensioni operative. - Monitorare i KPI tra cui disponibilità della flotta, uptime del veicolo, efficienza di spedizione, produttività del deposito e qualità operativa. - About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead the daily operations of autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleets across one or multiple depot locations.
- Ensure vehicles are operationally ready to support testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Monitor fleet utilization, vehicle availability, charging schedules, and operational readiness.
- Coordinate daily vehicle dispatch and return activities to maximize fleet efficiency.
- Minimize vehicle downtime through effective operational planning and coordination.
- Oversee all activities within the robotaxi depot, ensuring safe, efficient, and organized operations.
- Coordinate the work of Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists.
- Ensure vehicles meet cleanliness, charging, inspection, and maintenance standards before deployment.
- Support depot setup and operational readiness for new city launches and fleet expansion projects.
- Recruit, onboard, train, and supervise operational staff.
- Create shift schedules supporting 24/7 fleet operations.
- Conduct performance reviews and coaching sessions.
- Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure all team members follow operational procedures and safety standards.
- Act as the primary operational contact for internal and external stakeholders.
- Coordinate daily activities with engineering, product, technical, and fleet management teams.
- Prepare operational reports, KPI dashboards, and performance summaries.
- Escalate operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
- Support customer visits, audits, and operational reviews.
- Monitor KPIs including fleet availability, vehicle uptime, dispatch efficiency, depot productivity, and operational quality.
- Identify process improvement opportunities that reduce downtime and improve fleet performance.
- Develop and implement standard operating procedures for autonomous vehicle operations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives during robotaxi fleet scaling and commercial deployment.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, local regulations, and operational procedures.
- Promote a strong safety culture across all operational teams.
- Ensure incidents are properly investigated, documented, and resolved.
- Maintain compliance with health & safety requirements for fleet and depot operations.

## Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in fleet operations, automotive operations, transportation, logistics, mobility services, or similar operational environments.
- Previous experience leading operational or technical teams.
- Experience managing shift-based or 24/7 operations.
- Strong leadership and people management skills.
- Excellent organisational and planning abilities.
- Experience monitoring KPIs and operational performance.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluent English.
- Experience supporting autonomous vehicles, robotaxi fleets, ADAS programs, or automotive testing.
- Experience with electric vehicle (EV) fleet operations.
- Previous experience launching new operational sites or depots.
- Knowledge of fleet management systems and operational reporting tools.
- Additional European languages are an advantage depending on project location.

## What We're Looking For

Successful AV Operations Leads combine operational excellence with strong leadership and a passion for emerging mobility technologies.

You understand how to coordinate people, vehicles, depots, and processes while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving operational challenges as autonomous vehicle fleets expand into new cities and markets.

Whether supporting pilot programs or fully commercial robotaxi operations, you will play a key role in ensuring every vehicle, every shift, and every team member contributes to a safe and reliable autonomous mobility service.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to lead large-scale autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleet operations across Europe.
- Exposure to cutting-edge self-driving vehicle technologies and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Leadership role supporting new city launches, depot setup, and fleet expansion.
- Work alongside engineering, product, and operations teams shaping the future of autonomous transportation.
- Long-term career development within fleet management, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi operations.
- International projects supporting some of the world's leading autonomous vehicle programs.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development.

descriptions.it:
TSMG cerca Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead per attivita operativa sul territorio a Zurigo. Di seguito trovi il testo integrale dell'annuncio Lever, con responsabilita, requisiti e dettagli pratici del progetto. Siamo alla ricerca di un Autonomo veicolo Operations Lead (AVOS) per supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi (AV) e flotte robotassi che supportano programmi di test, servizi di ride-hailing autonomi commerciali, e nuove città lancia in tutta Europa. Come leader operativo all'interno del deposito, si coordina operatori di sicurezza, specialisti del deposito, tecnici senior e specialisti SDS per garantire che i veicoli rimangano sicuri, operativi e pronti per la distribuzione. Si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel mantenere la disponibilità della flotta, incontrare i KPI operativi, e sostenere il lancio e lo scaling di flotte autonome. Questa posizione è ideale per i candidati con esperienza nelle operazioni della flotta, nei servizi di mobilità, nelle operazioni automobilistiche, nella logistica o nei trasporti che godono di team leader in ambienti veloci e orientati alla tecnologia. ## Panoramica del progetto ## Principali responsabilità - Guidare le operazioni quotidiane di veicoli autonomi e flotte robotassi attraverso una o più sedi di deposito. - Assicurare che i veicoli siano pronti per supportare i test, la distribuzione commerciale e i servizi di guida autonomi. - Monitorare l'utilizzo della flotta, la disponibilità del veicolo, gli orari di ricarica e la disponibilità operativa. - Coordinare le attività quotidiane di spedizione e ritorno del veicolo per massimizzare l'efficienza della flotta. - Minimizzare i tempi di fermo del veicolo attraverso un'efficace pianificazione operativa e coordinamento. - Controllare tutte le attività all'interno del deposito robotassi, assicurando operazioni sicure, efficienti e organizzate. - Coordinare il lavoro di specialisti del deposito, operatori di sicurezza, tecnici senior e specialisti SDS. - Assicurare che i veicoli soddisfino la pulizia, la ricarica, l'ispezione e gli standard di manutenzione prima della distribuzione. - Installazione del deposito di sostegno e prontezza operativa per nuovi lanci della città e progetti di espansione della flotta. - Recluta, a bordo, treno e supervisiona il personale operativo. - Crea programmi di turni che supportano le operazioni della flotta 24/7. - Condurre recensioni sulle prestazioni e sessioni di coaching. - Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo. - Assicurare a tutti i membri del team di seguire le procedure operative e gli standard di sicurezza. - Agire come principale contatto operativo per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Coordinare le attività quotidiane con team di ingegneria, prodotto, tecnico e gestione della flotta. - Prepara report operativi, cruscotti KPI e sintesi delle prestazioni. - Escalare i rischi operativi e sviluppare piani di mitigazione. - Sostenere le visite dei clienti, gli audit e le recensioni operative. - Monitorare i KPI tra cui disponibilità della flotta, uptime del veicolo, efficienza di spedizione, produttività del deposito e qualità operativa. - Identificare opportunità di miglioramento del processo che riducono i tempi di fermo e migliorare le prestazioni della flotta. - Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard per operazioni autonome. - Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo durante la scalata della flotta robotaxi e distribuzione commerciale. - Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche aziendali, delle normative locali e delle procedure operative. - Promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in tutti i team operativi. - Assicurare che gli incidenti siano adeguatamente indagati, documentati e risolti. - Mantenere il rispetto dei requisiti di salute e sicurezza per le operazioni di flotta e deposito. ##
• Requisiti - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni della flotta, nelle operazioni automobilistiche, nei trasporti, nella logistica, nei servizi di mobilità o in ambienti operativi simili. - Esperienza precedente leader team operativi o tecnici. - Esperienza di gestione delle operazioni a turni o 24/7. - Forte leadership e competenze di gestione delle persone. - Eccellente capacità organizzative e di pianificazione. - Monitoraggio dell'esperienza KPI e prestazioni operative. - Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder. - Inglese fluente. - Esperienza di supporto veicoli autonomi, flotte robotassi, programmi ADAS, o test automobilistici. - Esperienza con le operazioni della flotta di veicoli elettrici (EV). - Esperienza precedente lancio di nuovi siti operativi o depositi. - Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della flotta e degli strumenti di reporting operativo. - Ulteriori lingue europee sono un vantaggio a seconda della posizione del progetto. ## Cosa stiamo cercando Il successo delle operazioni AV Leads combina l'eccellenza operativa con una forte leadership e una passione per le tecnologie di mobilità emergenti. Capisci come coordinare persone, veicoli, depositi e processi mantenendo i più elevati standard di sicurezza, efficienza e soddisfazione del cliente. Si prospera in ambienti dinamici e godere di risolvere le sfide operative come flotte autonome veicoli espandersi in nuove città e mercati. Se si supportano programmi pilota o operazioni robotassi completamente commerciali, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire ogni veicolo, ogni turno e ogni membro del team contribuisce a un servizio di mobilità autonoma sicuro e affidabile. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di condurre operazioni su larga scala autonome di veicoli e robotassi flotte in tutta Europa. - Esposizione a tecnologie auto-guida all'avanguardia del veicolo e servizi di guida autonomi commerciali. - Il ruolo di leadership che supporta nuovi lanci di città, la configurazione del deposito e l'espansione della flotta. - Lavorare insieme a team di ingegneria, prodotto e operazioni che modellano il futuro del trasporto autonomo. - Sviluppo di carriera a lungo termine nell'ambito della gestione della flotta, della mobilità autonoma e delle operazioni di robotica. - Progetti internazionali che sostengono alcuni dei principali programmi di veicoli autonomi del mondo. - Integrato onboarding e continuo sviluppo professionale.

TSMG is hiring Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead for field operations in Zurich. Below is the full Lever job description with responsibilities, requirements and practical project details.

About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead the daily operations of autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleets across one or multiple depot locations.
- Ensure vehicles are operationally ready to support testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Monitor fleet utilization, vehicle availability, charging schedules, and operational readiness.
- Coordinate daily vehicle dispatch and return activities to maximize fleet efficiency.
- Minimize vehicle downtime through effective operational planning and coordination.
- Oversee all activities within the robotaxi depot, ensuring safe, efficient, and organized operations.
- Coordinate the work of Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists.
- Ensure vehicles meet cleanliness, charging, inspection, and maintenance standards before deployment.
- Support depot setup and operational readiness for new city launches and fleet expansion projects.
- Recruit, onboard, train, and supervise operational staff.
- Create shift schedules supporting 24/7 fleet operations.
- Conduct performance reviews and coaching sessions.
- Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure all team members follow operational procedures and safety standards.
- Act as the primary operational contact for internal and external stakeholders.
- Coordinate daily activities with engineering, product, technical, and fleet management teams.
- Prepare operational reports, KPI dashboards, and performance summaries.
- Escalate operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
- Support customer visits, audits, and operational reviews.
- Monitor KPIs including fleet availability, vehicle uptime, dispatch efficiency, depot productivity, and operational quality.
- Identify process improvement opportunities that reduce downtime and improve fleet performance.
- Develop and implement standard operating procedures for autonomous vehicle operations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives during robotaxi fleet scaling and commercial deployment.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, local regulations, and operational procedures.
- Promote a strong safety culture across all operational teams.
- Ensure incidents are properly investigated, documented, and resolved.
- Maintain compliance with health & safety requirements for fleet and depot operations.

## Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in fleet operations, automotive operations, transportation, logistics, mobility services, or similar operational environments.
- Previous experience leading operational or technical teams.
- Experience managing shift-based or 24/7 operations.
- Strong leadership and people management skills.
- Excellent organisational and planning abilities.
- Experience monitoring KPIs and operational performance.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluent English.
- Experience supporting autonomous vehicles, robotaxi fleets, ADAS programs, or automotive testing.
- Experience with electric vehicle (EV) fleet operations.
- Previous experience launching new operational sites or depots.
- Knowledge of fleet management systems and operational reporting tools.
- Additional European languages are an advantage depending on project location.

## What We're Looking For

Successful AV Operations Leads combine operational excellence with strong leadership and a passion for emerging mobility technologies.

You understand how to coordinate people, vehicles, depots, and processes while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving operational challenges as autonomous vehicle fleets expand into new cities and markets.

Whether supporting pilot programs or fully commercial robotaxi operations, you will play a key role in ensuring every vehicle, every shift, and every team member contributes to a safe and reliable autonomous mobility service.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to lead large-scale autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleet operations across Europe.
- Exposure to cutting-edge self-driving vehicle technologies and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Leadership role supporting new city launches, depot setup, and fleet expansion.
- Work alongside engineering, product, and operations teams shaping the future of autonomous transportation.
- Long-term career development within fleet management, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi operations.
- International projects supporting some of the world's leading autonomous vehicle programs.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development.

Condurre recensioni sulle prestazioni e sessioni di coaching. - Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo. - Assicurare a tutti i membri del team di seguire le procedure operative e gli standard di sicurezza. - Identificare opportunità di miglioramento del processo che riducono i tempi di fermo e migliorare le prestazioni della flotta. - Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard per operazioni autonome. - Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo durante la scalata della flotta robotaxi e distribuzione commerciale. - Assicurare il rispetto delle politiche aziendali, delle normative locali e delle procedure operative. - Capisci come coordinare persone, veicoli, depositi e processi mantenendo i più elevati standard di sicurezza, efficienza e soddisfazione del cliente. Si prospera in ambienti dinamici e godere di risolvere le sfide operative come flotte autonome veicoli espandersi in nuove città e mercati. Se si supportano programmi pilota o operazioni robotassi completamente commerciali, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire ogni veicolo, ogni turno e ogni membro del team contribuisce a un servizio di mobilità autonoma sicuro e affidabile. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di condurre operazioni su larga scala autonome di veicoli e robotassi flotte in tutta Europa. - Esposizione a tecnologie auto-guida all'avanguardia del veicolo e servizi di guida autonomi commerciali. - Il ruolo di leadership che supporta nuovi lanci di città, la configurazione del deposito e l'espansione della flotta. - Lavorare insieme a team di ingegneria, prodotto e operazioni che modellano il futuro del trasporto autonomo. - Sviluppo di carriera a lungo termine nell'ambito della gestione della flotta, della mobilità autonoma e delle operazioni di robotica. - Progetti internazionali che sostengono alcuni dei principali programmi di veicoli autonomi del mondo. - Integrato onboarding e continuo sviluppo professionale.

TSMG is hiring Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead for field operations in Geneva. Below is the full Lever job description with responsibilities, requirements and practical project details.

About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Project overview

About the Role We are looking for an Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead (AVOS) to oversee the daily operations of autonomous vehicle (AV) and robotaxi fleets supporting testing programs, commercial autonomous ride-hailing services, and new city launches across Europe. As the operational leader within the depot, you will coordinate Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists to ensure vehicles remain safe, operational, and deployment-ready. You will play a critical role in maintaining fleet availability, meeting operational KPIs, and supporting the successful launch and scaling of autonomous vehicle fleets. This position is ideal for candidates with experience in fleet operations, mobility services, automotive operations, logistics, or transportation who enjoy leading teams in fast-paced, technology-driven environments.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead the daily operations of autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleets across one or multiple depot locations.
- Ensure vehicles are operationally ready to support testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Monitor fleet utilization, vehicle availability, charging schedules, and operational readiness.
- Coordinate daily vehicle dispatch and return activities to maximize fleet efficiency.
- Minimize vehicle downtime through effective operational planning and coordination.
- Oversee all activities within the robotaxi depot, ensuring safe, efficient, and organized operations.
- Coordinate the work of Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, Senior Technicians, and SDS Specialists.
- Ensure vehicles meet cleanliness, charging, inspection, and maintenance standards before deployment.
- Support depot setup and operational readiness for new city launches and fleet expansion projects.
- Recruit, onboard, train, and supervise operational staff.
- Create shift schedules supporting 24/7 fleet operations.
- Conduct performance reviews and coaching sessions.
- Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Ensure all team members follow operational procedures and safety standards.
- Act as the primary operational contact for internal and external stakeholders.
- Coordinate daily activities with engineering, product, technical, and fleet management teams.
- Prepare operational reports, KPI dashboards, and performance summaries.
- Escalate operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
- Support customer visits, audits, and operational reviews.
- Monitor KPIs including fleet availability, vehicle uptime, dispatch efficiency, depot productivity, and operational quality.
- Identify process improvement opportunities that reduce downtime and improve fleet performance.
- Develop and implement standard operating procedures for autonomous vehicle operations.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives during robotaxi fleet scaling and commercial deployment.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, local regulations, and operational procedures.
- Promote a strong safety culture across all operational teams.
- Ensure incidents are properly investigated, documented, and resolved.
- Maintain compliance with health & safety requirements for fleet and depot operations.

## Requirements

- Minimum 5 years of experience in fleet operations, automotive operations, transportation, logistics, mobility services, or similar operational environments.
- Previous experience leading operational or technical teams.
- Experience managing shift-based or 24/7 operations.
- Strong leadership and people management skills.
- Excellent organisational and planning abilities.
- Experience monitoring KPIs and operational performance.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Fluent English.
- Experience supporting autonomous vehicles, robotaxi fleets, ADAS programs, or automotive testing.
- Experience with electric vehicle (EV) fleet operations.
- Previous experience launching new operational sites or depots.
- Knowledge of fleet management systems and operational reporting tools.
- Additional European languages are an advantage depending on project location.

## What We're Looking For

Successful AV Operations Leads combine operational excellence with strong leadership and a passion for emerging mobility technologies.

You understand how to coordinate people, vehicles, depots, and processes while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving operational challenges as autonomous vehicle fleets expand into new cities and markets.

Whether supporting pilot programs or fully commercial robotaxi operations, you will play a key role in ensuring every vehicle, every shift, and every team member contributes to a safe and reliable autonomous mobility service.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to lead large-scale autonomous vehicle and robotaxi fleet operations across Europe.
- Exposure to cutting-edge self-driving vehicle technologies and commercial autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Leadership role supporting new city launches, depot setup, and fleet expansion.
- Work alongside engineering, product, and operations teams shaping the future of autonomous transportation.
- Long-term career development within fleet management, autonomous mobility, and robotaxi operations.
- International projects supporting some of the world's leading autonomous vehicle programs.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development.

descriptions.it:
TSMG cerca Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician (Robotaxi Fleet Maintenance & Technical Operations) per attivita operative sul territorio in Geneva. Di seguito trovi il testo integrale dell'annuncio Lever, con responsabilita, requisiti e dettagli pratici del progetto.

About the Role We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across Europe. As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical. You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware. This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

## Panoramica del progetto

About the Role We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across Europe. As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical. You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware. This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

## Key Responsibilities

- Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electric and autonomous vehicles used in robotaxi fleet operations.
- Ensure vehicles are technically ready for daily deployment, testing, commercial operations, and autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Conduct detailed vehicle inspections to support fleet readiness, vehicle uptime, and operational safety.
- Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, electronic, and software-related vehicle issues.
- Support maintenance workflows for high-availability autonomous vehicle fleets operating in shift-based or 24/7 environments.
- Perform advanced diagnostics on EV platforms, ADAS systems, autonomous driving hardware, and vehicle electronic systems.
- Use OEM diagnostic tools, service software, and technical procedures to identify root causes of vehicle faults.
- Troubleshoot issues related to battery systems, drivetrains, braking systems, steering systems, sensors, cameras, wiring, and vehicle control modules.
- Replace, repair, and validate vehicle components according to safety, quality, and technical standards.
- Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams with clear documentation and diagnostic findings.
- Work safely with electric vehicle systems, including high-voltage batteries, charging systems, inverters, and electric drivetrains.
- Follow strict high-voltage safety procedures when performing diagnostics, repairs, and component replacements.
- Support charging readiness and EV fleet availability in coordination with depot operations.
- Identify risks related to EV systems and escalate safety concerns immediately.
- Support installation, inspection, and replacement of autonomous vehicle hardware components.
- Assist with checks related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, compute units, wiring harnesses, sensor mounts, and related vehicle systems.
- Coordinate with SDS Specialists when issues involve the self-driving system, sensor calibration, or autonomous driving software.
- Ensure autonomous driving hardware remains properly installed, clean, functional, and ready for operation.
- Perform vehicle software updates, configuration changes, and validation checks according to defined procedures.
- Support post-repair testing to confirm vehicle functionality before returning the vehicle to robotaxi operations.
- Verify that repairs and maintenance actions do not impact vehicle safety, operational readiness, or autonomous system performance.
- Maintain accurate service records, diagnostic reports, and repair documentation.
- Act as the technical lead during assigned shifts when required.
- Provide guidance and escalation support to junior technicians, depot teams, and fleet operations staff.
- Support training of new technicians on vehicle maintenance procedures, safety standards, and operational workflows.
- Collaborate with Operations Leads to prioritize vehicle repairs and reduce fleet downtime.
- Help improve maintenance processes, vehicle turnaround time, and fleet reliability.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives related to fleet maintenance, depot operations, and autonomous vehicle deployment.
- Maintain a clean, organized, and safe technical workspace within the depot.
- Ensure all work is completed according to safety procedures, quality standards, and customer requirements.

## Requirements

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience as an automotive technician, service technician, EV technician, or diagnostic technician.
- Strong experience with automotive diagnostics, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair.
- Good understanding of electrical and electronic vehicle systems.
- Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical repair documentation.
- Ability to follow strict technical procedures and safety protocols.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a fast-paced operational environment.
- Comfortable working in shift-based operations, including evenings, weekends, or 24/7 fleet environments when required.
- Upper-Intermediate English.
- Experience working with electric vehicles, high-voltage systems, or modern EV platforms.
- High-voltage certification or EV safety training.
- Experience with ADAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or advanced automotive systems.
- OEM certification or dealership experience with EV or premium vehicle platforms.
- Experience supporting fleet maintenance, ride-hailing fleets, mobility services, or commercial vehicle operations.
- German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or other European languages depending on project location.

## What We Are Looking For

Successful Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians are highly precise, safety-focused, and comfortable working with complex vehicle systems. They understand that in robotaxi fleet operations, every repair, inspection, and diagnostic decision directly impacts fleet uptime, operational safety, and the success of autonomous mobility deployment.

You should be comfortable working in a depot environment where vehicles must be maintained, repaired, validated, and returned to service quickly and safely. This role requires a strong technical mindset, discipline, and the ability to collaborate with operations and engineering teams supporting self-driving vehicle programs.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to work with advanced electric and autonomous vehicle technologies.
- Hands-on involvement in robotaxi fleet operations, autonomous vehicle deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing services across Europe.
- Exposure to ADAS, self-driving systems, EV platforms, robotics, and next-generation mobility technologies.
- Structured onboarding and technical training.
- Long-term career development in autonomous mobility, EV fleet operations, and technical fleet maintenance.
- Collaborative work with operations, engineering, depot, and safety teams.
- Opportunity to support new city launches, fleet scaling, and commercial autonomous vehicle programs.

About the Role We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across Europe. As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical. You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware. This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

## Vue d'ensemble du projet

About the Role We are looking for experienced Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians to support the maintenance, diagnostics, repair, and operational readiness of autonomous vehicle fleets and robotaxi operations across Europe. As a Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring that electric and autonomous vehicles remain safe, reliable, and ready for daily deployment. This role supports autonomous ride-hailing services, robotaxi fleet operations, on-road testing programs, and new city launches where vehicle uptime, technical precision, and safety compliance are critical. You will work closely with AV Operations Leads, Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, SDS Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to minimize vehicle downtime and keep the fleet operational. The role combines hands-on automotive repair, EV diagnostics, high-voltage safety, software updates, and support for autonomous driving hardware. This position is ideal for an experienced automotive technician who wants to move into the future of mobility and work directly with electric vehicles, autonomous driving systems, ADAS technology, robotics, and self-driving vehicle platforms.

## Key Responsibilities

- Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electric and autonomous vehicles used in robotaxi fleet operations.
- Ensure vehicles are technically ready for daily deployment, testing, commercial operations, and autonomous ride-hailing services.
- Conduct detailed vehicle inspections to support fleet readiness, vehicle uptime, and operational safety.
- Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, electronic, and software-related vehicle issues.
- Support maintenance workflows for high-availability autonomous vehicle fleets operating in shift-based or 24/7 environments.
- Perform advanced diagnostics on EV platforms, ADAS systems, autonomous driving hardware, and vehicle electronic systems.
- Use OEM diagnostic tools, service software, and technical procedures to identify root causes of vehicle faults.
- Troubleshoot issues related to battery systems, drivetrains, braking systems, steering systems, sensors, cameras, wiring, and vehicle control modules.
- Replace, repair, and validate vehicle components according to safety, quality, and technical standards.
- Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams with clear documentation and diagnostic findings.
- Work safely with electric vehicle systems, including high-voltage batteries, charging systems, inverters, and electric drivetrains.
- Follow strict high-voltage safety procedures when performing diagnostics, repairs, and component replacements.
- Support charging readiness and EV fleet availability in coordination with depot operations.
- Identify risks related to EV systems and escalate safety concerns immediately.
- Support installation, inspection, and replacement of autonomous vehicle hardware components.
- Assist with checks related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, compute units, wiring harnesses, sensor mounts, and related vehicle systems.
- Coordinate with SDS Specialists when issues involve the self-driving system, sensor calibration, or autonomous driving software.
- Ensure autonomous driving hardware remains properly installed, clean, functional, and ready for operation.
- Perform vehicle software updates, configuration changes, and validation checks according to defined procedures.
- Support post-repair testing to confirm vehicle functionality before returning the vehicle to robotaxi operations.
- Verify that repairs and maintenance actions do not impact vehicle safety, operational readiness, or autonomous system performance.
- Maintain accurate service records, diagnostic reports, and repair documentation.
- Act as the technical lead during assigned shifts when required.
- Provide guidance and escalation support to junior technicians, depot teams, and fleet operations staff.
- Support training of new technicians on vehicle maintenance procedures, safety standards, and operational workflows.
- Collaborate with Operations Leads to prioritize vehicle repairs and reduce fleet downtime.
- Help improve maintenance processes, vehicle turnaround time, and fleet reliability.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives related to fleet maintenance, depot operations, and autonomous vehicle deployment.
- Maintain a clean, organized, and safe technical workspace within the depot.
- Ensure all work is completed according to safety procedures, quality standards, and customer requirements.

## Requirements

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience as an automotive technician, service technician, EV technician, or diagnostic technician.
- Strong experience with automotive diagnostics, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair.
- Good understanding of electrical and electronic vehicle systems.
- Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical repair documentation.
- Ability to follow strict technical procedures and safety protocols.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a fast-paced operational environment.
- Comfortable working in shift-based operations, including evenings, weekends, or 24/7 fleet environments when required.
- Upper-Intermediate English.
- Experience working with electric vehicles, high-voltage systems, or modern EV platforms.
- High-voltage certification or EV safety training.
- Experience with ADAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or advanced automotive systems.
- OEM certification or dealership experience with EV or premium vehicle platforms.
- Experience supporting fleet maintenance, ride-hailing fleets, mobility services, or commercial vehicle operations.
- German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or other European languages depending on project location.

## What We Are Looking For

Successful Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians are highly precise, safety-focused, and comfortable working with complex vehicle systems. They understand that in robotaxi fleet operations, every repair, inspection, and diagnostic decision directly impacts fleet uptime, operational safety, and the success of autonomous mobility deployment.

You should be comfortable working in a depot environment where vehicles must be maintained, repaired, validated, and returned to service quickly and safely. This role requires a strong technical mindset, discipline, and the ability to collaborate with operations and engineering teams supporting self-driving vehicle programs.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to work with advanced electric and autonomous vehicle technologies.
- Hands-on involvement in robotaxi fleet operations, autonomous vehicle deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing services across Europe.
- Exposure to ADAS, self-driving systems, EV platforms, robotics, and next-generation mobility technologies.
- Structured onboarding and technical training.
- Long-term career development in autonomous mobility, EV fleet operations, and technical fleet maintenance.
- Collaborative work with operations, engineering, depot, and safety teams.
- Opportunity to support new city launches, fleet scaling, and commercial autonomous vehicle programs.

- Support training of new technicians on vehicle maintenance procedures, safety standards, and operational workflows.
- Collaborate with Operations Leads to prioritize vehicle repairs and reduce fleet downtime.

- Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience as an automotive technician, service technician, EV technician, or diagnostic technician.

- Ability to follow strict technical procedures and safety protocols.

- Experience working with electric vehicles, high-voltage systems, or modern EV platforms.
- High-voltage certification or EV safety training.
- Experience with ADAS, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or advanced automotive systems.

Successful Senior Autonomous Vehicle Technicians are highly precise, safety-focused, and comfortable working with complex vehicle systems. They understand that in robotaxi fleet operations, every repair, inspection, and diagnostic decision directly impacts fleet uptime, operational safety, and the success of autonomous mobility deployment.

You should be comfortable working in a depot environment where vehicles must be maintained, repaired, validated, and returned to service quickly and safely. This role requires a strong technical mindset, discipline, and the ability to collaborate with operations and engineering teams supporting self-driving vehicle programs.

## What We Offer

- Opportunity to work with advanced electric and autonomous vehicle technologies.

- Opportunity to support new city launches, fleet scaling, and commercial autonomous vehicle programs.
